alertsPane.token5hDesc: Token usage rate alert for 5-hour window
alertsPane.idleAccountDesc: Alert when account is unused for a long time

alertsPane.globalDefaultDescription: Edit the default alert rules inherited by every account

codexPane.runtimeDesc: Manage official subscription and relay settings together, then sync the active profile to remote devices.
codexPane.officialLoginSuccess: Official account signed in and imported
codexPane.runtimeSwitched: Codex runtime profile switched; new processes use it immediately
codexPane.threadAffinity: Existing threads stay bound to their original provider and account. Switch back to that profile before resuming; fork a new thread to continue across providers.
codexPane.localSectionDesc: Review this machine's Codex identity and distribution role.
codexPane.cloudSectionDesc: Securely distribute or receive encrypted auth files through Gist.
codexPane.sshScanHint: Scan ~/.ssh/config to push auth and manage Claude Code endpoints per device.
codexPane.roleOwnerDesc: You own the account and upload auth files for others to sync
codexPane.roleConsumerDesc: You use a shared account and sync auth files from the cloud
codexPane.tokenExpiredWarn: Token expired. Please re-sync or re-login.
codexPane.noLocalAuth: No ~/.codex/auth.json found. Please login to Codex or sync auth first.

codexPane.pasteJsonImportHint: Supports sub2api export (multiple accounts), auth.json format, or a bare access_token. Verified automatically on import.
codexPane.proxyDesc: Used for Codex / Gist requests. Leave empty for the default proxy; direct connection is retried if the proxy fails.
codexPane.gistUrlPlaceholder: Gist URL or ID (raw URL of a secret Gist)
codexPane.autoSyncDesc: Auto-pull latest auth from Gist every 5 min (only applies on change)
codexPane.uploadDesc: Reads local auth.json → AES-256 encrypt → uploads to Gist. Upload periodically to keep tokens valid for others.
codexPane.autoUploadDesc: Automatically uploads when local auth changes (checks every 5 min)
codexPane.syncSuccess: Auth file synced to local machine
codexPane.syncDesc: Fetches encrypted file from Gist → decrypt → writes to ~/.codex/auth.json
codexPane.sshRemoteOverrideDesc: Scan local SSH config: sync the active Codex runtime profile; and switch the Claude Code GLM/DeepSeek endpoint remotely (independent from local).
codexPane.sshAutoOverrideDesc: Sync when the local Codex runtime profile changes (checks every 5 min)
codexPane.sshPushSuccess: Active Codex runtime profile synced to remote
codexPane.sshNeedPasswordPush: This host is not passwordless. Enter the password to sync Codex auth and configuration.
codexPane.sshNeedPasswordAuto: This host is not passwordless. Enter and save a password to enable auto override.
codexPane.sshNeedPasswordCc: This host is not passwordless. Enter and save a password to switch Claude Code endpoint remotely.
codexPane.sshCcBindDesc: Pick a local account and model to write into remote ~/.claude/settings.json (independent from local)
codexPane.sshCcBindSuccess: Remote Claude Code endpoint updated (open a new session on the remote to take effect)
codexPane.sshCcNoAccount: No GLM/DeepSeek account yet. Add one in Accounts first.
codexPane.jsonImportEnabledSub2api: Detected sub2api export format; Sub2API management is now enabled (toggle off in Settings → General)
